name: Prismio Packages
description: The package registry for Prismio, a statically typed systems language that compiles through LLVM. Browse libraries and publish from the Prismio command line. Preview: the registry is under development and the packages listed are examples.
status: Preview. Prismio 0.3 has no package registry; the packages listed on the site are examples and are not published libraries.
publishing: command line only; no website upload
